programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fills in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton), comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can effect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler into a new personality.

programme.title: Andromeda: Cui Bono
programme.desc: Bekkas farbror kandiderar till ett ämbete i det nya samväldet, men ett mordförsök får besättningen att agera som hans säkerhetsvakt.

programme.title: Andromeda: Den ensamma och jämna sanden
programme.desc: När Andromeda attackeras av rymdpirater räddas de av ett sedan länge försvunnet rymdskepp från jorden.

programme.title: Andromeda: Slipfighter det krigshundarna
programme.desc: Besättningen upptäcker att en oseriös planet, Marduk, har skapat massförstörelsevapen.

programme.title: Andromeda: Den Lepers kyss
programme.desc: En torped vid namn Leper har ledarna för det nya samväldets ledare som måltavla.

programme.title: Andromeda: För vem klockan ringer
programme.desc: Andromeda hemsöks av en mystisk varelse som kommer ombord under en solstorm.

programme.title: Andromeda: Och ditt hjärta kommer att flyga iväg
programme.desc: När en förlorad kärlek återvänder försvinner Tyr från skeppet för att skydda henne från en lönnmördare.
programme.sub-title: Och ditt hjärta kommer att flyga iväg

programme.title: Andromeda: Den oövervinneliga mannen
programme.desc: Den utspelar sig i ett alternativt universum där Dylan dog och Gaheris Rhade försöker reformera Samväldet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Delenda Est
programme.desc: Gruppen som attackerade Andromeda under det första undertecknandet av Samväldets stadgar återvänder för att ställa till med mer förödelse.

programme.title: Andromeda: Det mörka bakåt
programme.desc: Trance går igenom ett antal olika scenarier och försöker hitta ett där hennes besättningskamrater inte dör.

programme.title: Andromeda: Det Risk-allt-punkten
programme.desc: Ett kraftfullare Andromedaskepp exploderar på grund av sabotage, vilket tvingar Dylans besättning att rädda dem.

programme.title: Andromeda: Den rätta hästen
programme.desc: Beka äventyrar både hennes besättning och en hel planet när en tidigare kärlek dyker upp.

programme.title: Andromeda: Vad händer med en uppskjuten Rev?
programme.desc: Andromeda får ett rop på hjälp från Rev Bam.
programme.sub-title: Vad händer med en uppskjuten Rev?

programme.title: Andromeda: Spjutspetsen
programme.desc: När en planet i Samväldet attackeras av pyroformare från Pyrianer tvingas Dylan kämpa för att skydda den nya planeten.

programme.title: Andromeda: Himlarnas valvet
programme.desc: Dylan hör röster som lockar honom till en planet med "eld och is".

programme.title: Andromeda: Djup Midnatt:s Röst
programme.desc: Medan besättningen är fångad i en strid mellan två Nietzscheanska-stolthet, fångar besättningen en fiende som hävdar att hans stolthet har en karta över glidströmmen.

programme.title: Andromeda: Illusionen om majestät
programme.desc: En felaktig sväng efter att ha lämnat en glidström skickar Andromeda in i Prolon-systemet. De räddar en flyktkapsel från en säker katastrof, men stoltheten vill ha den tillbaka.

programme.title: Andromeda: Idolernas skymning
programme.desc: Besättningen letar efter en förlorad koloni av Nietzscheanerna och upptäcker en annan besättning som i hemlighet har hjälpt dem.

programme.title: Andromeda: Domens dag, vredens dag
programme.desc: Besättningen installerar en ny AI i ett nytt slagskepp från Samväldet, och naturligtvis går saker och ting inte som de ska.

programme.title: Andromeda: Skuggor som kastas av en sista salut
programme.desc: Tyr övertygar Nietzscheanerna om att han är en reinkarnation av Drago Museveni.
programme.sub-title: Skuggor som kastas av en sista salut

programme.title: Andromeda: Svar på frågor som aldrig ställts
programme.desc: Ett meddelande från en samlare skickar Dylan på ett uppdrag att rädda en gisslan och hitta resterna av Samväldets flotta.
programme.sub-title: Svar på frågor som aldrig ställts

programme.title: Forensic Files: Pastoral Care
programme.desc: In 1981, New York correctional officer Donna Payant disappeared and was later found in a landfill. The medical examiner not only identified the cause of death, but also found an important clue.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bagging a Killer
programme.desc: In 1999, 9-year-old Valiree Jackson vanished on her way to school near Spokane. Her father, Brad Jackson, reported the disappearance and the entire community started searching for her abductor.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Double Trouble
programme.desc: In 1995, when off-duty Maine State Trooper Vicky Gardner is attacked by Steven Fortin during a routine stop, it triggers a chain of events which jumpstart a stalled murder case in New Jersey.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cats, Flies & Snapshots
programme.desc: When 19-year-old Lori Auker left her Pennsylvania home for work and never arrived, it took space-age technology, cat hairs and insects to pinpoint the woman's abductor.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Naked Justice
programme.desc: When Leann Fletcher is found dead, investigators use blood spatter analysis and forensic computing to find a motive for her murder: her husband, a prominent lawyer, was having an affair with judge Susan Chrzanowski.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Treading Not So Lightly
programme.desc: By using techniques she saw on forensic science TV shows, a mother determines who was responsible for the accident that permanently injured her 4-year-old daughter.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shopping Spree
programme.desc: When a woman and her daughter didn't return home from shopping, her husband directed police to a nearby mall. The child's body was found, but there was no sign of the wife.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Forever Hold Your Peace
programme.desc: When Chris Ochoa confessed to the 1988 rape and murder of Nancy DePriest, the case was closed. 8 years later, Achim Marino confessed to the same crime. Can DNA evidence identify the real perpetrator?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Reel Danger
programme.desc: When two boys are brutally attacked, investigators rely on evidence fished out of a nearby pond. It became the first case where diatom analysis was used to place a suspect at the scene of the crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Who's Your Daddy
programme.desc: In 1988, the body of a young woman was discovered in an Ohio river. Most of the evidence had been washed away, but the victim's 6-year-old son unwittingly told investigators all they needed to know — without saying a word. The clue was in his genes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Alibi
programme.desc: In 1991, a high school girl vanished after attending a party. The prime suspect had two alibi witnesses for the night she disappeared. A solid alibi can often overcome circumstantial evidence, but forensic evidence is another matter.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Purr-fect Match
programme.desc: When police discovered the body of Douglas Beamish's estranged wife, authorities linked 20 cat hairs found on her jacket to a cat owned by Beamish's parents. It was the first time animal DNA was used to solve a criminal case.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bio-Attack
programme.desc: When more than 700 Oregonians contracted food poisoning from a unique strain of salmonella in 1984, investigators uncovered a secret plot to influence local elections.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Shot in the Dark
programme.desc: Two sets of scientists probe a woman's death.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Without a Prayer
programme.desc: In 1995, the founder of American Atheists disappeared with one of her sons, her granddaughter and $500,000 in gold coins. The police investigated several suspects, including David R. Waters, who worked for American Atheists.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Clutch of Witnesses
programme.desc: Two eyewitnesses may hold the key to the death of a motorcycle gang member.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Scout's Honor
programme.desc: In 1984, a passerby finds the torso of a woman in a cardboard box. A forensic entomologist analyzes nearby insect activity to determine when the victim was killed.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Touching Recollection
programme.desc: The investigation into the kidnapping and rape of an 18-year-old Ohio woman is aided when the victim returns hours after the incident occurred. With her help, the police are able to track the assailant to his front door.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Leg to Stand On
programme.desc: The police investigate when a severed leg is discovered among garbage. Conventional means of identifying the victim are impossible, leading investigators to rely on DNA, forensic anthropology and toxicology.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Partners in Crime
programme.desc: In a 1992 murder case, the autopsy of a cremated body turns up telltale clues of foul play.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Within a Hair
programme.desc: In 1996, Indiana police identified Richard Alexander as the “River Park Rapist” who assaulted four women that year. Later, DNA analysis casts doubt on his conviction.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Chief Evidence
programme.desc: After the 1996 murder of Seattle residents Raquel Rivera and Jay Johnson, evidence from the couple's dog eventually ties one of the murderers to the scene.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Bitter Pill to Swallow
programme.desc: Soon after becoming pregnant by Dr. Maynard Muntzing, firefighter Michelle Baker's health quickly deteriorates. Eventually, she raises suspicions that Muntzing is doing her harm.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Political Thriller
programme.desc: In 2006, Nevada politician Kathy Augustine died mysteriously during a re-election campaign. The medical examiner could neither isolate the cause of death, nor explain the tiny puncture wounds discovered during the autopsy.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Double Cross
programme.desc: In 1996, Virginia Beach police arrive at the Makdessi apartment to find the bloodied bodies of Elise Makdessi and Navy sailor Quincy Brown. But was Brown Elise's lover or her assailant?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dancing with the Devil
programme.desc: In 1999, Patrick McRae was found dead in his Des Moines home and the crime scene was awash with blood. Analysis showed it had come from two people, one of whom was female.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Last Dance
programme.desc: In 2000, the body of exotic dancer Rachel Siani was found beneath a New Jersey bridge. Investigators wondered if she had committed suicide. They discovered that Rachel offered to assist a drunk customer named John "Jack" Denofa to his motel room.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Constructive Criticism
programme.desc: In 2000, construction manager Darrell North was found dead in his work trailer in Ft. Worth, Texas. When investigators arrived, they found that he had been stabbed 46 times, indicating a personal relationship between the victim and the attacker.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Home Evasion
programme.desc: In 2000, Judy Southern arrived home from work and was shot by a gunman waiting within. Her husband arrived shortly afterwards, called emergency services and drove her to the hospital.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Window Watcher
programme.desc: In 1986, Gary Dale Larson was stabbed to death in his Edmond, Oklahoma home. The killer then sexually assaulted Larson's girlfriend, Janet Haynes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Stranger in the Night
programme.desc: In 1991, Dorothy Donovan was murdered in her Dover, Delaware home. When her son stated that she was murdered by a hitchhiker he had picked up, police were skeptical.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Kidnapping
programme.desc: In 2001, Ginger Hayes and her infant son were abducted during a carjacking. The crime had been reported by a witness within minutes of occurrence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sands of Crime
programme.desc: In the early hours of a morning just before Christmas, a college student was abducted from the parking lot of her apartment. Her body was found later that day; she had been sexually assaulted and shot at point-blank range.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Calculated Coincidence
programme.desc: A young woman is found dead in her apartment. With little evidence at the scene, the case turns cold — until police discover a link between their prime suspect and an unsolved murder committed six years earlier in a different state.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sworded Scheme
programme.desc: When a college student is reported missing, police believe their investigation will be like countless others. But when they discover blood spatter in her boyfriend's bedroom, they know this case is going to be different.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Unmasked
programme.desc: A serial rapist is on the loose in a Texas town. No one knew where he'd strike next, but the audacity of his attacks and the escalation of violence against his victims made finding him imperative.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fashion Police
programme.desc: The victim had been stabbed more than thirty times and the crime scene was awash with her blood. Near her head, police discovered a distinctive button with strands of thread still attached.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Church Dis-service
programme.desc: A young woman attends evening church services, then disappears. When her abandoned car is found, the tank is empty and a gas can she kept in her trunk for emergencies is missing.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Seedy Intentions
programme.desc: When a 9-year-old girl goes missing, police and volunteers spend weeks searching for her. A psychic's vision leads to a field where her body is discovered, along with what investigators hope is enough evidence to find her killer.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.
programme.sub-title: The True Story of Mississippi Burning

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Stolen Identity
programme.desc: When a theft is committed, something valuable is stolen. But when a criminal needs a new identity, theft becomes a matter of life and death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Critical Evidence
programme.desc: To the astute detective and forensic specialist, the biggest clues often hide in plain sight, and what seems trivial to some is in reality Critical Evidence.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Grave Secrets
programme.desc: Killers often attempt to deflect attention away from their crimes by hiding the remains of their victims. Bodies may lay hidden for years before they are discovered.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Silent Killers
programme.desc: Weeks pass as forensic investigators search for even the smallest clues, only to find what they feared in their own backyard. In Canada, two people die suddenly of unknown causes, and their deaths may not be as coincidental as they first appear.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Flames Of Justice
programme.desc: Arson fires are set for their own sake, or to cover a different crime, such as murder. Think fire consumes all vital clues? Think again. Arson investigators can glean important clues from scorched rubble and ignite the unquenchable flames of justice.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Military Justice
programme.desc: The Naval Criminal Investigative Service uses forensic science to solve three perplexing murders and fulfill their motto: "To the living we owe respect; to the dead, we owe the truth."

programme.title: The New Detectives: Medical Examiners's Casebook
programme.desc: Some killers choose to hide their victims. And investigators must then rely on forensic examiners to uncover proof of murder. These are just two extraordinary crimes that have made their way into the medical examiner's casebook.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Raw Greed
programme.desc: A friendly Midwest lodge becomes the scene of a gruesome double murder. Two men are dead and a safe filled with cash is missing.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Silent Witness
programme.desc: Three hairs, microscopic fibers, a common trash bag ripped from a roll. Seemingly small and insignificant clues become a victim's silent witness.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Blood Money
programme.desc: Some people murder for love. But these killers did it for the money. When greed is the motive, investigators must make every clue pay off.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Coroner's Casebook
programme.desc: A good coroner provides what's necessary to solve a crime. A bad one can spoil an otherwise rock-solid case. Cyril Wecht and Henry Lee, two of the country's most respected coroners, share their cases and insights into crime solving.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Absent Witness
programme.desc: When killers hide or destroy the remains of their victims, it becomes the mission of forensic scientists to reconstruct the scenes and prove murder for an absent witness.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Dead Men Do Talk
programme.desc: Profiles the work of world-renowned forensic experts and the procedures they use to solve murders and other mysteries in minutes or centuries after they happen.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Web of Clues
programme.desc: Forensic Entomology: Bugs have roamed the earth for 250 million years, but their intimate association with death is just now coming to life.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fateful Twist
programme.desc: A southeastern Virginia community is stunned by a crime no one can believe. A pregnant woman murdered, her baby lost. Across the state, another town feels a similar shock, a brutal, random slaying in a most unexpected setting.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Marked For Death
programme.desc: Sometimes killers are careful to leave no fingerprints behind. But methods of the murder itself can leave a lasting impression on police, especially when the tools (or weapons) of a killer's trade leave an innocent victim marked for death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trails of Evidence
programme.desc: In criminal investigations, a simple clue can provide the missing link by placing a suspect at a crime scene. Dirt left on shoes, tires or clothes, or even a tiny piece of plastic can pinpoint a crime scene.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Lockdown: The Club
programme.desc: One haunted members only club and a bar full if spirits. Ghost Dimension capture ghostly goings on, inside of Aintree Conservative Club. A place never investigated before and has paranormal activity daily.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Lockdown: Ghosts of The Asylum
programme.desc: Paul and Sean visit one very haunted Asylum in Manchester and come to face with ghostly souls that are haunting the building. The Asylum housed the criminally insane and it would appear, as the building closed, some of them never left!

programme.title: Ghost Dimensions Top 10 Scariest Moments
programme.desc: A special look into the top 10 of Ghost Dimension’s scariest moments. Venturing into the UK’s most haunted buildings, we take a look back at the scariest captures.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Bulkeley Hotel
programme.desc: The former home of Queen Victoria is now home to many spirits who have been seen by guests and staff. Witness the first ever formal documentation of the paranormal activities in the Bulkeley Hotel.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Plas Teg
programme.desc: The county of Flintshire in Wales is said to be a land filled with ghosts and haunts. Plas Teg is said to be one of the "most haunted" houses in the area. With over 400 years of history, this place is sure to be the home of many an entity.

programme.title: Past Hunters: The Block
programme.desc: The team investigate a disused factory in Burton-Upon-Trent. Reports of paranormal happenings are common and the team are ready for anything.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Mill Street Barracks
programme.desc: Built in 1861 Mill Street Barracks is steeped in rich history. It has accommodated many branches of the armed forces throughout its life. Like many other barracks it has also been used as a morgue making it a prime location for the supernatural.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Hack Green Secret Nuclear Bunker
programme.desc: The Hack Green Secret Nuclear Bunker is a former government-owned nuclear bunker located at Hack Green, Cheshire, England. It Started as a decoy site for enemy bombers but later developed into a legitimate base. Now it is ripe with hauntings.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Drakelow Tunnels
programme.desc: The Drakelow Tunnels are a former underground military complexused mainly for storage. However, during the construction and running of this facility, 6 people are thought to have died.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Razor Ruddock's Home
programme.desc: We visit the home of Soccer legend Neil "Razor" Ruddock which seems to be haunted. Is it his home specifically? Or are these ghosts attached to him?

programme.title: Past Hunters: Blackpool Pleasure Beach
programme.desc: Blackpool Pleasure Beach is one of the most visited attractions in the United Kingdom. People visit it not only for the fun, but to also hopefully catch a glimpse of the many ghosts that haunt there.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Whitby Hall
programme.desc: Built in the early 1800s, Whitby Hall used to be an administrative center and now stands as a public park and arts center. It has never before been investigated, but staff have reported many noises and presences among them.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Lockdown: Ewloe Castle in North Wales
programme.desc: Ghost Dimension's Bex and Sean head to Ewloe Castle in North Wales, believed to be haunted by ghosts and spirits. What will they uncover as they delve deep into the castle ruins? and seek out its hauntings.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Lockdown: Legh Arms Historic Hauntings Part 1
programme.desc: Ghost Dimension's Bex and Sean travel to Knutsford, Cheshire and visit the Legh Arms.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Lockdown: Legh Arms Historic Hauntings Part 2
programme.desc: A 16th Century pub that has a haunted history. The duo come into direct contact with spirits haunting the location. Even during the day there is no shortage of ghostly activity, on this lock down special paranormal Ghost Dimension investigation.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Lockdown: Family Full of Ghosts
programme.desc: The duo come into direct contact with spirits haunting the location. Even during the day there is no shortage of ghostly activity, on this lock down special paranormal Ghost Dimension investigation.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Lockdown: Norris Green Mansion Part 1
programme.desc: Many urban explorers have encountered paranormal activity inside of the building, including child like figures, unexplained voices and strange knocking sounds. Will anything from the ghost dimension make contact?

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Lockdown: Norris Green Mansion Part 2
programme.desc: Ghost Dimension's Bex and Sean investigate Norris Green Mansion. A 17th Century building, which is believed to hold some of the most haunted spirits in Liverpool. Will they make contact its ghostly entities tonight?

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Lockdown: House of Hauntings
programme.desc: Ghost Dimension's Bex and Sean head to New Mills and investigate a home situated on the grounds of death and destruction from the bombings of WW2. Will any of the spirits lost in this disaster come forward and make contact during the investigation today?

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Lockdown: Haunted Crank Caves
programme.desc: Ghost Dimension's Bex and Sean investigate some of the most haunted caves systems in the world. Crank Caves. Located in St Helens, myths and legends surround this labyrinth of tunnels and the team seek out paranormal claims of ghostly activity

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Lockdown: Halloween Special Chillingham Castle
programme.desc: Ghost Dimension's Bex and Sean investigate Chillingham Castle for a Halloween investigation. The most haunted castle in the world. Reports of paranormal activity are daily here, so what will the team manage to capture tonight?

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Lockdown: Poltergeist House
programme.desc: Ghost Dimension investigate a Poltergeist haunting a homeowner who is a wits end. Poltergeistal activity in the home is terrorizing the tenant and paranormal investigators Bex and Sean are about to start the exorcism of this demonic entity away for good.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Newlyweds Headed for Divorce
programme.desc: Misty hates her best friend's newlywed man so much that she's willing to pay for the divorce. Lucus is ready to divorce his wife of six weeks if her family doesn't stop meddling!

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Candid Confessions!
programme.desc: Mistie says that her man has been disloyal, but never guessed her best friend! Jose's two boyfriends don't know that they've been sharing him. Antjuan hates that his girlfriend strips for a living.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Baby, I've Been Bad!
programme.desc: Tonya wants to tell her man that she's pregnant and cheating with her transsexual roommate, Gina! Mike has been sleeping with his fiancé’s cousin for a year! Then, Jimmy has a pregnant fiancé AND girlfriend!

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Angry Lovers Explode!
programme.desc: Hope is here to confront her best friend, Laura, for stealing her boyfriend, Joey, and then becoming engaged to him. Next, John will claim he's not to be blamed for sleeping with his girlfriend's best friend!

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Three Sisters Share A Man!
programme.desc: Kenny lived with sisters Lora and Misty, who are also his lovers but he treats them like servants. Later, Jerry confronts Kenny with the results of the nine positive paternity tests, but Kenny says he only cares about two of his nine children.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: It's Your Fault I'm Cheating!
programme.desc: Anita is ready to dump her husband for her ex-lover. Next, Theresa is cheating on her fiancé with his brother! Later, Kevin is here to tell his girlfriend's ex, Jermaine, to back off.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Furious Women Face Off!
programme.desc: Carl is here today to tell his girlfriend that he's been sleeping with her sworn enemy, Keisha. Next, Donte will tell his best friend, Quincy, that he's sleeping with his fiancé. Later, Janel and Nikkie are fighting over the same man.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Two-Timers Confronted!
programme.desc: Kiki and Kat were coworkers who fell in love. But now Kat is dumping Kiki for a man! Later, Cedric is here to tell his girlfriend that he wants to take their relationship to another level… and person!

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Amazing Tales
programme.desc: Fred deceived his lover Jay, so now Jay wants his just desserts! Next, Terry's obsession over his stuffed panda is about to drive his girlfriend away! Then, Benny will tell his buddy that he secretly wears women's underwear.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Shocking Secret Lovers
programme.desc: Dave says his girlfriend's constant nagging has driven him into the arms of a 72-year-old woman! Next, Joe is about to tell his beautiful girlfriend that he had a one-night stand with a shocking person!

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Invasion of the Angry Lovers
programme.desc: Josh and Amy will find out today that their partners have been unfaithful. Next, Madeline reveals to Andre that she's been sleeping with Diante. Then, Quincy is engaged to Callie but she doesn't know that Quincy has been cheating with Amy.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Bizarre Love Affairs
programme.desc: Jen is going to tell John that she is dumping him for her secret lover, 73-year-old Jerry. Next, Danika has a little surprise for her fiancé which she feels compelled to tell him that she's really a man.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: A Man and His Food: A Love Story!
programme.desc: John weighs almost 700 pounds and couldn't be happier. HIs girlfriend Kim goes so far as to make him choose between her and a 10-foot long sandwich! He chooses the sandwich.
programme.sub-title: A Man and His Food: A Love Story!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Forbidden Love
programme.desc: At twelve, Crystal dated 20-year-old Matt and was pregnant at 13. He served 15 months for sexual assault on a minor and is a registered sex offender. Is this inappropriate love or a misunderstanding?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: 16-Year-Old Surrogate Stole Our Baby
programme.desc: Sarah was Dawn and Derek's surrogate, but took off while five months pregnant. Sarah claims that they took advantage of her. Who are the baby's rightful parents?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: She's a Crazy Stalker
programme.desc: Victor met Jasmine a few years ago but claimed they never had sex. Jasmine claims that they fell in love and want him back! Who's telling the truth?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: These DNA Results Will Floor You
programme.desc: Joe met “Jessica” on a phone chat line. A few months later, she revealed she was pregnant. Then, Chastity claims that her ex Trent fathered her child. What will the DNA results reveal?
programme.sub-title: These DNA Results Will Floor You

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: I Punch a Woman like I Punch a Man
programme.desc: Chelse claims that her 19-month-old daughter is Malcolm's and that he beat her while pregnant. Amber and Phillip accuse each other of being abusive and want the polygraph tests to prove their claims!
programme.sub-title: I Punch a Woman like I Punch a Man

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: I Slept Around: Who's the Dad?
programme.desc: Tasha wants to prove to her ex Martin that he fathered her four-year-old. Martin's sister says that the child might belong to her boyfriend Terrence. Who's the real father?
programme.sub-title: I Slept Around: Who's the Dad?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Extreme Deception Indicated
programme.desc: Joe and Tammy have been together for six years and they have two children. Joe faces cheating accusations again and returns to Steve's stage for his lie detector results!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Steve, I Think He's Gay
programme.desc: Monique’s friend claims that Adrian advertised himself on a “Gay for Pay” website. Then, pregnant Tyeasha suspects David of cheating on her with men. What will the polygraph say?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: I Wouldn't Wish This on Anybody
programme.desc: On today's Steve Wilkos, will the lie detector results reveal if Tamisha and Simone's men were faithful? Or will it reveal some more sinister results?
programme.sub-title: I Wouldn't Wish This on Anybody

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: The Devastating Truth
programme.desc: Desiaree refuses to believe her sister or mother's accusations against her father. Are their lies are keeping him in prison? Find out today!

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Who's a Better Kisser
programme.desc: Brodys och Heidis vänskap står vid ett vägskäl efter att en middag spårat ur. Medan Brody undrar om Amber är rätt för honom blir frågorna bara fler för Audrina efter första kyssen med Sean. Justin öppnar sig för gruppen.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: You Told Her?!
programme.desc: Heidi och Spencer får en chock när deras beteende har blivit ett samtalsämne. Audrina står vid ett vägskäl med Brody och Sean. Caroline gör ett djärvt ställningstagande angående Kaitlynn.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: I'm Back in LA Bitches!
programme.desc: Gänget firar Kristin Cavallaris besök i L.A. Det blir spänt mellan Heidi och Audrina, men Justin och Jason stärker sin vänskap. En bra kväll går över till en bra morgon när Brody och Audrina sätter sin personkemi på prov.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: "Who Slept at Your House?"
programme.desc: Kristin grillar Brody om övernattningen med Audrina. Rykten börjar gå under en resa till Lake Tahoe, och Kaitlynn känner sig utanför. Caroline konfronterar Kaitlynn om deras kyliga relation, och Jason hör att Spencer ifrågasätter hans nykterhet.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Get Dessert and Bail
programme.desc: Brodys and Audrinas flirt blir intensivare. Kriget mellan Pratts and Wahlers når kokpunkten, medan Brandon inte vet hur han ska tolka Danis kyliga respons när han föreslår att de ska flytt aihop. Audrinas och Heidis vänksap når ett vägskäl.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Time Heals Not Some Things
programme.desc: Heidi och Spencer söker hjälp för att få hjälp med sin ekonomi. Medan Kaitlynns nya förhållande fortsätter att blomstra hotar en flirt från Brandons förflutna att förvärra situationen med Dani. Justin återupptar kontakten med sin pappa.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: That's Math Right There
programme.desc: Kaitlynns beslut att flytta ihop med sin kille får alla att undra vad det är som händer. Heidi & Spencer oroar sig för sitt företag, medan Brandon omvärderar sitt förhållande och Audrina inser saker om Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: What About Me?
programme.desc: På Speidis hälsoretreat ryktas det om att Kaitlynn är gravid. Brandon har chockerande nyheter om sitt förhållande. Paret Wahler har svårt att hålla sams med paret Pratt, som är distraherade av möjliga kommande förändringar i deras liv.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Timing Is Everything
programme.desc: Kaitlynn berättar för Brody att hon är gravid men oroar sig för mötet mellan honom och Kris på retreatet. Pratts & Wahlers tar äntligen itu med grälet som har splittrat gruppen och Justin inser vikten av att hålla kontakten.

programme.title: The Hills: New City, New Drama
programme.desc: Lauren Conrad försöker balansera modeskola, en praktikantplats och en rumskamrat som saboterar hennes event för jobbet och inser snabbt att allt är större i Los Angeles - även hennes problem.

programme.title: The Hills: A Change of Plans
programme.desc: Heidi lyckas få en intervju för sitt drömjobb, vilket får henne att fundera på att hoppa av skolan för gott och får Lauren att inse att hon och Heidi kan vara inne på helt olika banor.

programme.title: The Hills: An Unexpected Call
programme.desc: Teen Vogue skickar Lauren på ett ärende över natten som tar henne till New York City, men när hon återvänder till LA finner hon en överraskning från det förflutna. Heidi inser att livet inte är en fest bara för att man arrangerar fester.

programme.title: The Hills: Lauren and Jason: Part 2
programme.desc: När Jason, Laurens ex från Laguna Beach, dyker upp i hennes liv igen inser Lauren att hon kanske inte har kommit över honom lika mycket som hon trodde. Samtidigt börjar Heidi undra om hennes nya jobb verkligen är värt det.

programme.title: The Hills: Jason's Birthday
programme.desc: Lauren skyndar sig hem från ett Teen Vogue-event för att tillbringa Jasons födelsedag med honom, men kvällen går inte riktigt som väntat. Audrina söker råd från Heidi om hennes senaste dejt med modellen och skådisen Danny.

programme.title: The Hills: Boyfriends and Work Don't Mix
programme.desc: Jason distraherar Lauren mer och mer från både jobbet och skolan. Heidi får äntligen sin stora chans att jobba på nattklubb, men det kunde inte ha kommit olägligare.

programme.title: The Hills: Somebody Always Has to Cry
programme.desc: Det är gängets första stora helgdag i LA, och inte alla får vad de har önskat sig. Lauren har svårt att få sig en nyårskyss när Jason får veta att hon oväntat fått kontakt med ett gammalt ex.

programme.title: The Hills: You Can't Just Be With Me?
programme.desc: Jason vill göra Laurens 20-årsdag speciell, men när hon ljuger om att jobba med manliga modeller för Teen Vogue utsätts deras förhållande för en stor prövning.
programme.sub-title: You Can't Just Be With Me?

programme.title: The Hills: Love is Not a Maybe Thing
programme.desc: Heidi har äntligen fått nog av all dramatik med Jordan. Lauren och Jason funderar på att ta nästa steg i deras förhållande.
programme.sub-title: Love is Not a Maybe Thing

programme.title: The Hills: Timing is Everything
programme.desc: När Laurens slit med LA Fashion Week kan leda till ett stort steg i karrirären har hon svårt att välja mellan hennes jobb och hennes pojkvän.

programme.title: The Hills: Out With The Old
programme.desc: Sommaren med pojkvännen Jason gick inte så bra, så Lauren bestämmer sig för att göra slut och återvända till Teen Vogue för att möta sin chef, som inte är glad. Heidi har problem med killen som både hon och Audrina dejtar.

programme.title: The Hills: When You Least Expect It
programme.desc: Lauren går på sin första dejt sen det tog slut med Jason och får en stor utmaning på jobbet när hon får uppgiften att jobba med en modevisning. Heidi har en chockerande hemlighet som hon måste berätta för sin pojkvän.

programme.title: The Hills: The Best Night Ever
programme.desc: När Audrina objuden dyker upp på Heidis födelsedag blir hon snart varse om att Heidi inte är redo att förlåta henne. Lauren, fast besluten att koncentrera sig på jobbet, faller för en charmig ny kille i hennes liv - Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: Who Do You Trust?
programme.desc: Audrina berättar för Heidi om Spencers vänsterprassel, men Heidi tror inte på henne - förrän hon ser det med egna ögon. Lauren är fortfarande inte säker på om hon är redo för ett nytt förhållande.

programme.title: The Hills: One Big Interruption
programme.desc: Heidi tar en paus från Spencer men saknar honom mer än hon hade trott. Lauren ska planera en Teen Vogue-middag, men superpraktikanten Emily från New York tar över.

programme.title: The Hills: You Have Chosen
programme.desc: När Lauren berättar för Heidi vad hon egentligen tycker om Spencer måste Heidi välja mellan sin bästa vän och sin pojkvän.

programme.title: The Hills: With Friends Like These...
programme.desc: Lauren inser att hon inte kan lita på sin bästa vän när Heidi sammanför Jen och Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: Enough Is Enough
programme.desc: Spencer ber Heidi att flytta in hos honom, men Heidi vet inte vad hon ska göra eller hur hon ska berätta det för sin rumskompis Lauren.

programme.title: The Hills: New Year, New Friends
programme.desc: Laurens 21-årsdag är full av överraskningar när Heidi och Audrina håller en överraskningsfest för henne. Jen försöker sluta fred med Lauren.

programme.title: The Hills: Apology Not Accepted
programme.desc: Lauren fyller 21 och Heidi har stora planer för födelsedagskalaset. Men innan festen bestämmer hon sig för att berätta för Lauren att Spencer vill att de ska flytta ihop.

programme.title: The Hills: Goodbye for Now
programme.desc: I säsongsfinalen blir det spänt när Heidi måste besluta om hon ska flytta ihop med Spencer eller inte. Lauren vänder sig till Audrina när hon vill fylla tomrummet efter sin bästa vän, och Whitney flyger till New York för en intervju.

programme.title: The Hills: You Know What You Did
programme.desc: Lauren går inte på Heidis and Spencers inflyttningsfest, efter att ha hört att Heidi spridit rykten om henne. När Lauren och Heidi springer på varandra har de sitt hittills största gräl.

programme.title: The Hills: Big Girls Don't Cry
programme.desc: Lauren och Heidi kommer ännu längre från varandra när Spencer friar till Heidi. Audrina menar allvar med en pojkvän från förr och Lauren återvänder till Laguna Beach för att fråga om råd.

programme.title: The Hills: Truth And Time Tells All
programme.desc: Lauren försöker hjälpa Audrina att avgöra om Justin har det som krävs av en pojkvän, men Audrina har redan bestämt sig. Heidi märker att det inte alls är kul att vara förlovad och börjar flörta.

programme.title: The Hills: Meet The Parents
programme.desc: Med betoning på komiken får du se din favoritgrupp i reality-genren. Från Lauren till Spencer och alla mellan dem. Inget bitchigt ansiktsuttryck eller försök till fördjupad vänskap undgår våra blickar.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Jacques Comeuppance
programme.desc: Jacques Fraser får till slut sitt straff. Det nyaste exet stormar stranden och villan, sätter en kil mellan Sean och Zahida, och skapar kaos för resten.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Aaron Moves On
programme.desc: Två nya ex kommer, till Aarons glädje och Beccas förtvivlan. Maisie når sin absoluta botten, Harriette får en spektakulär härdsmälta, och Sean och Jack brakar samman.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Big Fat Greek Wedding
programme.desc: Terrorpaddan tillkännager ett stort grekiskt bröllop för Sean och Zahida, men när det sista exet kommer blir det kaos av firandet. Harriette får chockerande besked från Ross.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Welcome to Ex on the Beach
programme.desc: Tio profiler från realityvärlden och sociala medier tror att de är på en sexig semester, men paradiset blir en mardröm när deras ex börjar komma upp på stranden och förstöra nöjet. Blir det nytändningar eller bara bråk?
programme.sub-title: Welcome to Ex on the Beach

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Exed Out
programme.desc: Ett nytt ex kommer med en hemlighet som skakar om huset. Ett av exen röstas bort, och par och tidigare par får möta sina värsta mardrömmar i Hemlighålet.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Two Exes Don't Make a Right
programme.desc: Huset får avgöra vem som har det värst, när en singel hamnar i kläm mellan två ex och en annan får möta sitt värsta ex. En sexig dejt urartar i kaos.
programme.sub-title: Two Exes Don't Make a Right

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: I Wanna Call You Babe
programme.desc: Angela vänder sig till sitt ex när hon får veta vad som hände mellan hennes karl och en annan. De två kvinnorna som slåss om Chase börjar plötsligt slåss om husets nya kille.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Who's Exed Next?
programme.desc: Exen får överraskande nog all makt, Derrick smider planer och försöker manipulera huset, två nya ex anländer, och den ena är mer välkommen än den andra.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Bye Alicia Hi Alicia
programme.desc: Cory's ex Alicia kommer tillbaka och skapar kaos i huset. Ett ex skickas till stranden för första gången. Smutsiga hemligheter avslöjas i Hemlighålet, och alla blir överraskade av elimineringen.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Party Foul
programme.desc: Paulie och Lexi har äntligen definierat sitt förhållande, men Hemlighålet hotar att förstöra deras tid i paradiset. Ett nytt ex anländer för att göra sitt ex svartsjuk och kommer till festen med buller och bång - bokstavligen.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Monster Mode
programme.desc: Jasmine frestas att ta in en ny man och kasta ut nån annan. När Alicia ger Cory en utskällning dras alla in i dramatiken. Förhållanden står på spel när exen riskerar sin plats i huset.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: You Can't Handle the Truth
programme.desc: Corys relation till Taylor är i fara när hans känslor för Alicia uppdagas. En kommentar utlöser ett storbråk i huset. Ett nytt ex anländer och får ett oväntat besked.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Return of all the Exes
programme.desc: Huset är i chock när alla utslagna ex kommer tillbaka. En oskyldig lek blir allvar när Angela och Derrick gör nåt de inte borde. Huset omgrupperar efter det stora bråket.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Can You Ever Get Over Your Ex?
programme.desc: En tripp till SOS hotar att splittra det nyligen återförenade paret. Chase's lek med kärlekstrianglar får konsekvenser. Singlarna måste bestämma sig - lämna Hawaii med kärleken, eller ensamma.
programme.sub-title: Can You Ever Get Over Your Ex?

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Love at First Sight
programme.desc: Åtta kändissinglar träffas i en lyxvilla. Det slår gnistor för Joey, Calum får en överraskning och Lateysha blir förtjust i en "bad boy". Första kändisexet dyker upp men kommer det att sluta i tårar?

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Breaking Point
programme.desc: Att träffa Joey och Lorena igen blir för mycket för Ellie. Lateysha får nobben av Michael, men en sexig ny kändis tar henne till sjunde himlen. Calum och Marisa fortsätter flörta.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Will You Be My Girlfriend?
programme.desc: Calum hamnar i kläm mellan två ex, Marissa och Victoria, och Marissa är inte glad. Joey har en stor fråga till Lorena, och Ashley hamnar i kompisbubblan.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: May The Best Man Win
programme.desc: Joey och Lorena blir ett par, men lyckan hotas av nån. David börjar tveka på Laytesha. Ashley får lite tur, och Michael och Victoria kommer varandra närmare.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: A New Celeb's In Toon!
programme.desc: Gänget får ett speciellt besök på båtfesten, Georgia inser sitt misstag, och för antingen Itay eller Victoria är det över.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: The Queen Has Arrived
programme.desc: Lateysha och David får en chock när realitydrottningen Tiffany Pollard kommer och avslöjar David känslor för Lateysha. Två ex lämnar villan.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Battle of the Divas
programme.desc: Känslorna svallar när Victoria slits mellan Michael och en nyanländ. Lateysha får ett utbrott när Marissa flörtar med David, och Joey framför en romantisk rap för Lorena.

programme.title: Are You The One?
programme.desc: Bara en chans återstår och de taktiska korten är utspelade, så alla hoppas hitta sin perfekta partner. Amber slits mellan tre tänkbara kandidater.

programme.title: Are You The One?: How Far Would You Go For Love? Part 1
programme.desc: Kärleksgnistorna sprakar när 22 otursförföljda singlar från världens alla hörn träffas på Kanarieöarna för att se om de kan hitta den rätta och vinna en miljon dollar.
programme.sub-title: How Far Would You Go For Love? Part 1

programme.title: Are You The One?: How Far Would You Go For Love? Part 2
programme.desc: Ett par separerar och går vidare, medan andra par tror sig ha hittat rätt. Pressen ökar när paren sätts på prov i den första Parceremonin.
programme.sub-title: How Far Would You Go For Love? Part 2

programme.title: Are You The One?: Rollecoaster Relationships
programme.desc: Efter en trist parceremoni kämpar vissa singlar vidare, medan andra agerar själviskt vilket drabbar hela huset. Ärliga samtal om viljor och behov leder till sårade känslor.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Love Is Hell, Finding It Is Hell
programme.desc: En fest ger upphov till nya flörter, och en kärlekstriangel tar form när en av singlarna börjar tänka på första natten.
programme.sub-title: Love Is Hell, Finding It Is Hell

programme.title: Are You The One?: Wants And Needs
programme.desc: Sanningsbåset skakar om huset, och ett par hamnar i en jobbig kärlekstriangel. Ett annat par tvingas göra slut när pressen från de andra blir för stor.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Down The Rabbit Hole
programme.desc: När singlarna släpper loss på fest riskerar svartsjukan att sätta käppar i hjulet för ett par. Frustrationen stiger när huset inser att bara ett av de starka paren skulle kunna vara rätt.

programme.title: Are You The One?: It Takes One To Know One
programme.desc: Några gäster kommer med råd och tips om hur man hittar den rätta. Sanningsbåset avslöjar den skiftande dynamiken i huset.
programme.sub-title: It Takes One To Know One

programme.title: Are You The One?: Stricking Out
programme.desc: Äntligen kan Kamie bekräfta ett par vid Parceremonin. Ett favoritpar får veta sitt öde. Ett annat ångrar sin separation.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Kiss And Tell
programme.desc: Will får sota för att ha bevarat sitt förhållande med Courtney samtidigt som han letade den rätta. Huset visar upp dolda talanger.

programme.title: Are You The One?: You Were The One
programme.desc: Efter veckors debatterande om hur de ska hitta den rätta samarbetar nu singlarna i ett riskabelt försök att hitta äkta kärlek.

programme.title: Are You The One?: You Can't Handle the Truth
programme.desc: Tio singeltjejer och tio singelkillar tillbringar en månad ihop och försöker hitta sin perfekta partner. Om de lyckas får de dela på det största priset i MTV:s historia - en miljon dollar.

programme.title: Are You The One?: The Temptation of Chris T
programme.desc: Chris T riskerar hela priset på en miljon dollar eftersom han inte kan släppa Shanley, och när Ryans dagböcker försvinner söker han tröst hos Kayla - som i sin tur söker tröst hos Wes.

programme.title: Are You The One?: A Real 'G'
programme.desc: Det blir alltmer spänt mellan Jacy och Simone medan de kämpar om Johns gunst. Det tänder till mellan Brittany och Adam när de får åka till boom-boom-rummet , och i utmaningen avslöjar tjejerna pinsamma gamla saker om sig själva.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Karma's a Bitch
programme.desc: Utmaningen består i att killarnas ex avslöjar allt och sen tillbringar kvällen i huset. Brittany verkar inte fatta att Adam helt enkelt inte är intresserad. Coleysia och Ashleigh påbörjar egna romanser.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Double Shot
programme.desc: Läget är spänt mellan John och Simone. Kayla blir intresserad av Wes igen, men hon håller ändå kvar vid Ryan. Gänget blir på glatt humör när de får skicka två par till sanningsbåset efter vattenfallstävlingen.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Turn The Paige
programme.desc: Alla försöker att klura ut vilket som är nästa perfekta par. Kayla avslöjas när hon spelar ut Ryan mot Wes, och Simone försöker att splittra Chris T och Shanley för gott. Ett besök i sanningsbåset vänder upp-och-ned på huset.

programme.title: Are You The One?: It's So Hard... To Say Goodbye
programme.desc: Kaos råder i huset efter att Paige och Chris T visar sig vara ett par och de skickas på smekmånad. Shanley är uppriven för att hon och Chris T. skiljs åt. Och Kayla blir hysterisk när Ryan går iväg för att trösta Jessica.
programme.sub-title: It's So Hard... To Say Goodbye

programme.title: Are You The One?: Getting Dumped On
programme.desc: Kayla och Ryan grälar och hela huset vänder sig emot Kayla när hon avslöjar en känslig sak som kan hota Ambers förhållande med Ethan. En slipprig utmaning visar om vissa par klarar av att hänga ihop.

programme.title: Are You The One?: White Party
programme.desc: Hela gänget släpper loss och har kul på vita festen, men John måste ta itu med det faktum att Jacy börjar få känslor för Scali. En strandtävling tvingar paren att sanda ner sig.

programme.title: More Beautiful for Having Been Broken
programme.desc: En sönderbruten FBI-agent som kämpar med förlusten av sin mor reser till en liten bergsstad där hon blir vän med en pojke med särskilda behov som har den extraordinära förmågan att hela andra genom sin unika syn på livet. Denna film visas utan undertexter

programme.title: The Killing of a Sacred Deer: The Killing of a Sacred Deer
programme.desc: Kirurgen Steven verkar utåt sett lycklig med sin familj, men är samtidigt bäste vän med sextonårige Martin som verkar ha någon hållhake på sin vän; frågan är vad den udda vänskapen grundar sig i, och vad den kan få för konsekvenser.

programme.title: Boulevard: Boulevard
programme.desc: En tråkig bankman (Robin Williams) utmanas när han oväntat tar en ny riktning i livet och väljer kärleken.

programme.title: The Little Shop Of Horrors
programme.desc: En butiksanställd upptäcker en mystisk växt med en blodtörstig aptit. Framgång följer, men priset visar sig vara människoliv, och situationen eskalerar.

programme.title: Benjamin
programme.desc: I Simon Amstells gripande, bittersöta komedi, kastas en ung, framstående filmskapare in i emotionell turbulens av en spirande romans och den kommande premiären av hans andra långfilm.

programme.title: White Oleander
programme.desc: I ett anfall av sjuklig svartsjuka förgiftar den kompromisslösa och förföriska konstnären Ingrid sin älskare. Hon döms till livstids fängelse och hennes 15-åriga dotter Astrid får därefter flytta runt mellan olika fosterfamiljer.

programme.title: Boulevard: Boulevard
programme.desc: En tråkig bankman (Robin Williams) utmanas när han oväntat tar en ny riktning i livet och väljer kärleken.

programme.title: Coach Carter
programme.desc: En inspirerande berättelse om basketcoachen Ken Carter, som fick både kritik och beröm när han skapade rubriker efter att han bänkat hela sitt obesegrade lag på grund av deras dåliga studieresultat.

programme.title: Paterson
programme.desc: Paterson (Adam Driver) är busschaufför i staden Paterson, New Jersey. Varje dag kör han sin dagliga rutt under vilken han observerar staden när den flimrar förbi genom vindrutan och lyssnar samtidigt på fragment av passagerarnas konversationer.

programme.title: Tully
programme.desc: En ny dramakomedi från teamet bakom Juno med Charlize Theron i huvudrollen som Marlo.

programme.title: Bleeder
programme.desc: Louise älskar Leo djupt, hjärtligt och unreservedly och lyckligtvis glad när hon upptäcker hon är gravid. Men för Leo är den oförutsedda graviditetsfallet,

programme.title: The Whistleblower
programme.desc: Den unga polisen Kathy stationeras i det krigshärjade Bosnien, där hon drömmer om att få vara med om att bygga upp landet på nytt. Men istället snubblar hon rakt in en värld av korruption och människohandel.

programme.title: A Bronx Tale
programme.desc: 9-årige Calogero bor i ett italienskt kvarter i Bronx. En dag bevittnar han ett mord som begås av den lokale maffiabossen Sonny. Calogero väljer att inte tjalla på Sonny, och som tack blir Sonny hans extrapappa. Calogeros hederlige far kan dock inte...

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: From California to Kentucky, few living near a railroad felt safe in the summer of 1999. A serial killer, rode the rails, picking towns and victims at random. He left behind a trail of bloodshed, but no trace of where he would turn up next.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In Las Vegas, a gang of robbers target an ATM repository and hit the jackpot. Their take was over a million dollars in cash, the largest heist in Las Vegas history.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Millionaire Murder
programme.desc: A businessman went to Florida to make one last deal before he retired-he never returned home to his millions. Authorities examined who was closest to him and who stood to gain from his disappearance. But this time conventional rules didn't apply.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In Georgia, a series of bizarre shootings terrorized a small town. Two people were killed. Two others were critically wounded. At first, the shootings seemed targeted. Then they seemed random.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In this special episode, we take a closer look at cases previously featured on this series. Our goal is to explore more fully some of the investigative methods and techniques that have made the FBI the premier law enforcement agency in the world.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1980s, the United States faced a deadly new enemy abroad, an expanding network of terrorists targeting American interests. Hundreds of innocent people were killed in bombings, executions, and hijackings.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Mission
programme.desc: When a family was murdered in Arkansas, it seemed like an isolated event. But soon the crime was revealed to be part of an ever-widening circle of violence that defined a new age of domestic terrorism.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Takeover
programme.desc: Two armed bank robbers hit a Seattle bank taking over 150,000 dollars. Before they can escape police confront them and the pair splits up. As authorities search block by block they learn one was a career criminal with a long history of violence.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: A criminal who kills a police officer wages war on society. In 1987 such a criminal vanished after shooting two Boston officers, one fatally. He had a history of violence against cops and the protection of a group of outlaws.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cracking The Cartel
programme.desc: A mother and child are kidnapped a bystander is murdered. Violence such as this shattered a quiet Texas neighborhood and exposed a drug cartel that flourished where it was least expected.

programme.title: Bikini Spring Break
programme.desc: A group of coeds from a small conservative college break out of their shells when their marching band bus breaks down in Ft. Lauderdale during Spring Break.

programme.title: A Good Old Fashioned Orgy
programme.desc: När Eric Kepplers pappa meddelar att han tänker sälja kompisgängets älskade semesterhus i Hamptons har de svårt att fatta att det är sant. Eric vill ha en sista pangfest och bestämmer sig för att hålla en orgie för honom och vännerna.

programme.title: Are You Here
programme.desc: Ben och vännen Steve återvänder hem när Bens pappa gått bort. Till Bens chock ärver han en hel del mer än pengar. Samtidigt som Ben kämpar med sitt nya ansvar, sätts vänskapen med Steve på spel på grund av arvet, kärlek och hans systers ambitioner.

programme.title: Dating Amber
programme.desc: Tonåringarna Eddie och Amber växer upp i en irländsk småstad under 1990-talet. Alla misstänker att de är gay och varje dag är en kamp. De blir ihop på låtsas och inser att en påhittad relation kan vara minst lika komplicerad som en äkta.

programme.title: Youth In Revolt
programme.desc: Gilbert Grape bor i Endora, med sin autistiska lillebror Arnie och sin rörelsehindrade mamma, ger det honom lite tid för ett eget liv. Så en dag kommer Becky till Endora och det uppstår en alldeles speciell vänskap mellan henne och Gilbert.

programme.title: Now Add Honey
programme.desc: Carolines liv är i fullständigt fritt fall. Hennes döttrar driver henne till vansinne och hennes otacksamma chef håller på köra slut på henne samtidigt som hennes man lämnar henne.

programme.title: Kalla mig Dave
programme.desc: Det är inte för att han är besvärlig, blyg eller klädd i discokläder som Dave Ming Chang sticker ut i New York. Det beror på att han är en utomjording! Närmare bestämt ett utomjordiskt rymdskepp...

programme.title: Meet the Spartans
programme.desc: Striden börjar när den heroiska Leonidas, endast beväpnad med läderunderkläder och en bortkastad mantel, leder en brokig skara på 13 (ja, 13!) krigare för att försvara sitt hemland.

programme.title: Epic Movie
programme.desc: Två av de skeva författarna till Scary Movie siktar nu in sig på den största genren av dem alla: Hollywoods storbudgeterade, specialeffektsladdade, storsäljande franchisefilmer.

programme.title: Black Knight
programme.desc: När en klok svart hustler från South Central i Los Angeles befinner sig transporterad tillbaka till medeltida England, leder han störtandet av en ond kung och vinner hjärtat av en protofeministisk kvinna.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
programme.desc: Leo Guzman falls off a ladder while painting a house. At first, his death seems to be an open-and-shut case but, as the autopsy unfolds, Dr. G believes there may be more to this case.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Josiane Bézard Case
programme.desc: On the morning of January 9th 2014, Josiane Bézard, 53 years old, drives her son to the Manosque's train station, and then vanishes.

programme.title: City Confidential
programme.desc: Murders are rare in tranquil Delta Township, Michigan. So when a well-liked couple is gunned down in their home, residents are terrified--until police discover the monster accidentally left a trail of breadcrumbs leading right to his door.

programme.title: Exhibit A: Episode 13
programme.desc: A consummate con artist is finally trapped in an elaborate sting. Can a skilled forensic psychologist prevent her from succeeding in a final, clever deception?

programme.title: Bizarre Murders: Episode 152
programme.desc: A small town celebrity goes missing, just as body parts start tuning up around town.

programme.title: True Crime Scene: High Rollers
programme.desc: One night, Las Vegas casino mogul, Ted Binion tells his lawyer: "Take Sandy out of the will, if she doesn't kill me tonight". Next morning, Binion shows up very dead and his girlfriend Sandy is the top suspect.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
programme.desc: Police make a grisly discovery: a woman’s battered and dead body. With little evidence and no witnesses, Dr. G must identify the body and determine the cause of death to catch her killer.

programme.title: Mind Investigators: The Evil
programme.desc: In June 2011, a man is arrested for brutal domestic homicide.

programme.title: American Justice
programme.desc: A relentless detective leaves no stone unturned until the entire truth behind a young woman's brutal death is exposed and everyone responsible for taking her life is brought to justice.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Britain: Joanne Dennehy
programme.desc: Dermot Murnaghan returns to uncover the truth behind the horrific crimes of Peterborough serial killer Joanna Dennehy.

programme.title: Exhibit A: Episode 4
programme.desc: Maggots that have eaten away the face of an unknown victim could turn out to be the key to solving the brutal murder.

programme.title: City Confidential
programme.desc: The folks of Lexington, Kentucky love two things: horses and University of Kentucky sports. But in 1994, it wasn't March Madness or the Triple Crown that had this college town on the edge of its seat.

programme.title: Under Arrest: Drunk Puppet
programme.desc: Brothers are involved in a bloody stabbing, police force entry to try and stop an assault and investigators are called to a suicide.

programme.title: Women Behind Bars
programme.desc: Alice receives two life sentences for her role in the slaying of two men. Then, Sarah claims that she made a false murder confession simply to earn a gang status symbol.

programme.title: Women Behind Bars
programme.desc: This episode features a woman who was convicted of killing an elderly woman and another who allegedly sexually violated a 21-year-old woman and then left her to die in a closet.

programme.title: Exhibit A: Double Jeopardy
programme.desc: In this case, a forensic scientist misinterprets the facts surrounding a shooting, thereby allowing the guilty party to walk free. But the victim’s mother won’t let the case rest. Eventually she gathers enough evidence to reopen the case

programme.title: City Confidential
programme.desc: The center of Idaho's potato empire, there's nothing bland about this Northwestern town. Spud money has given Boise a sprinkling of big-city sophistication and a dollop of crime.

programme.title: Unsolved Murders
